reviews.text: Many thanks for your 5 star rating Olwyn! 👍 …

In January I adopted a feral dog with no human interaction and Donna came highly recommended by 4 professionals working in the industry...and I can see why! Cricket & Donna have not even met yet and we have had 1 x 60 min zoom call and 1 x 30 min followup and the results have just been outstanding in two weeks. I really can't thank her enough. From her positive approach and commitment to gaining trust with an animal through onsent orientated practice and training...to her "think outside  the box" ideas on games and interactions. Who would have thought a simple 5 euro cat toy would shift my little dog's brain in a matter of minutes. She is an absolute Dog send and if you do the work, you will reap the rewards. I love that her approach is super individualised to the dog and their circumstance rather than a "one size fits all" approach. I can't wait to see how we progress but I can already see the results ten fold in a short space of time. If you are having behavioural issues with your pet, this is the trainer for you.
Donna from Clever Pets has been an amazing support to us after rehoming our little boy. After just one session she equipped us with the tools and knowledge to help our little boy. Highly recommend.

We recently used Donna when rehoming another dog. At first, our existing dog and the new dog were fighting and so we were very stressed.
A session with Donna was just what we needed. After implementing what we learnt - they are now great friends! We would definitely recommend Donna to anyone looking for help with their dogs!

Donna from Clever Pets has been a tremendous help with our dog Heidi, who has anxiety and socialisation issues, both with people she is unfamilar with and other dogs. Donna has given me the training tools to continue with Heidi's improvement. I can highly recommend Clever Pets to help with with your dog's problem behaviour.
Donna is very patient and a expert when it comes to training dogs.Highly recommend

Donna at Clever Pets gave great training, tips and support to help train my dog and reduce my stress levels when we met other people and other dogs when out walking!  One year on, walks are great fun and relaxed, thanks Donna.

My lovely Pomeranian called Archie has been with Donna for his obedience and behaviour classes. Archie has done extremely well with all his classes. When I got Archie in May 2022 he was a very neglected 15 week old pup, but now a very well trained confident young dog. All his classes with Donna have made an amazing difference
Donna is fantastic with dogs. We could see huge improvements with our dog using her training after only a few days. She included the kids in the training and made it fun for them and the dog.
Donna is very friendly and doggies loved her. Even after 1 session difference in our dog is huge and hoping to get even better. Highly recommending service she provides 😁 …
